notes.subject: singaut olsem laion
notes.rationale: שאג is the lion's roar/rumble; Tok Pisin needs 'singaut olsem laion' to keep the picture.

notes.subject: roar-mourn-wither
notes.rationale: Lion-roar of Yahwe cascades into mourning pastures and withered Carmel — sound of judgment hitting the land.

notes.subject: ⟨autim⟩
notes.rationale: נתן קולו is literally 'give his voice'; 'autim' added to carry the sense of uttering.

translation: Na Yahwe i tok: Long Tsaion bai em i singaut olsem laion, na long Yerusalayim bai em i givim ⟨autim⟩ vos bilong en; na ol ples gaden bilong ol man i lukautim sipsip bai i karai, na het bilong Karmel bai i drai.
